title: Pixel count, pushed to the limit.
Which one do you like?

yt.title: Pixel Count Pushed to the Limit. Which One Do You Like? #shorts #satisfying #math
yt.desc:
The same picture, from 4 x 4 (16 pixels) up to 1024 x 1024 (about 1.05 million pixels), doubling the width and height each step. Which one do you like?

How it works:
- The picture is the Mandelbrot set. For each point, square and add over and over; points that never blow up are dark, and the rest are colored by how fast they escape.
- Each step reveals finer detail along the edge. This shape keeps showing new detail no matter how far you go.
- Every step plays the next note up a C major scale.

Picture, sound and animation: original (computed in Python).
